description: How one exercise has gone over time, as the app's exercise screen shows it: every workout it was in, newest first, with the sets (weight kg, reps, RPE, time s, distance m, and reps_left — how many more reps the set had in it, which is how the app asks effort), the best set (the heaviest, then most reps) and its weight in kg (top_weight_kg), volume, mean RPE, hard sets (within three reps of failure) and whether it was a PR (heavier, or the same weight for more reps). Nothing is estimated. For "how is my bench press improving", read top_weight_kg and best_set over time. Needs the sets category.

client.description: For a coach: a client id from list_clients, to read that client. Omitted: your own account.

from.description: First day, inclusive. Omitted: all history.
